blocks.title: Conjugated diene
blocks.text: Diene woh molecule hai jis mein carbon atoms ke darmiyan do double bonds hon. Conjugated diene mein carbon zanjeer ke double bonds ek single bond se alag hote hain.

Conjugated diene ke sath sath double bonds teen ya zyada sath wale atoms par p orbitals ke overlap ki ijazat dete hain. Yeh overlap electrons ki delocalisation deta hai, jo molecule ko mustahkam kar sakti aur us ki reactivity par asar dal sakti hai; conjugated dienes mein pi overlap poore system par phaila hota hai. Conjugated alkenes apne double bonds ki tarteeb ki wajah se munfarid khusoosiyat rakhte hain; buta-1,3-diene jaise conjugated dienes synthetic rubber banane mein istemal hote hain, conjugated banawat polymerisation se rubber jaisi khusoosiyat wali lambi zanjeerein banane deti hai.

blocks.alt: CH2=CH-CH=CH2, but-1,3-diene; CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2, CH3 doosre carbon ke oopar, 2-methylbut-1,3-diene (isoprene); aur C-C-C-C zanjeer jis ke har carbon par oopar neeche p orbital lobe, oopar neeche lehardar lakeeron se jure: 'Delocalization of pi electrons of the conjugated bonds'.
blocks.caption: Conjugated dienes aur pi electrons ki delocalisation (kitab ke safha 265 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron carbons ke p orbitals sath sath khare hain, is liye pi electrons sirf do carbons ke darmiyan nahi rehte balkay poori zanjeer par phail jate hain (delocalisation); lehardar lakeerein yahi phaila hua pi badal dikhati hain. Kitab mein 'pie electrons' chhapa hai; sahi 'pi electrons' hai.

blocks.caption: Conjugated aur alag-thalag dienes
rows: do alag pi bonds, koi delocalisation nahi

blocks.prompt: Buta-1,3-diene banayein, us ke electrons ki delocalisation dikhayein, aur wazeh karein ke conjugated alkenes alag-thalag alkenes se mukhtalif kyun react kar sakte hain (Quick Check 11.10; exercise Q.2h).
blocks.explanation: CH2=CH-CH=CH2: ek satah mein chaar sp2 carbons, har ek ke saath p orbital; kyunke carbons 1 se 4 ke p orbitals sab mutawazi aur sath sath hain, woh zanjeer ke oopar neeche musalsal patti mein overlap karte hain, to chaar pi electrons do bonds mein muqarrar hone ke bajaye poore system par phaile hain. Yeh delocalisation energy ghatati hai, to diene do alag-thalag double bonds se zyada mustahkam hai, aur electrophile ek double bond ke saath saath siron ke paar (1,4-addition) bhi jur sakta hai.

items: Conjugated diene: C=C-C=C, double bonds ek single bond se alag; p orbitals teen ya zyada atoms par overlap kar ke pi electrons delocalise karte hain, jo molecule ko mustahkam karta hai; buta-1,3-diene synthetic rubber mein polymerise hota hai.
